scripts.check: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/velox-core-check.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p packages/servers/tsconfig.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/velox-servers-check.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p packages/agent/tsconfig.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/velox-agent-check.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web/tsconfig.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/velox-web-check.tsbuildinfo && tsc --noEmit -p packages/veloxcheck/tsconfig.json --pretty false --tsBuildInfoFile /tmp/velox-veloxcheck-check.tsbuildinfo && vitest run --reporter=dot
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:servers" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev -w @velox/web"
